title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E11 — Martha's Garden Tours of Turkey Hill and Bedford
Martha visits her former home, Turkey Hill, where everything began for Martha in the 1970s; then back to her Bedford farm for a garden club tour - a peek inside Martha's gardens past and present.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S1 E12 — Color For All Seasons
One of the joys of gardening is planning for beautiful color all through the year; bulbs and tubers are at the center of this show because of their beautiful blooms from spring to winter.

title: Martha Gardens
description:
S2 E1 — Martha's Easy Foundation Landscaping Project
Martha redesigns the foundation landscaping around one of the homes on her Bedford Farm, providing step-by-step instructions on how to complete a successful landscaping project with ease and intent.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E9 — Perfect Weekend Breakfast
Martha invites Oscar de la Renta co-creative director Laura Kim to her kitchen to create her Instagrammable and aesthetically pleasing recipes.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S5 E10 — Jacques Pepin Cooking His Way
Culinary legend Jacques Pepin brings his authentic French flavors to Martha's kitchen, crafting a delicious, flavorful menu.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E1 — Martha Throws an Argentine Asado BBQ
Martha is throwing a very special BBQ called Asado; plus Martha prepares a chimichurri sauce, her daughter Alexis's chopped salad and for dessert, fruit flavored popsicles; a perfect celebration.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E2 — The Perfect Jams to Pair With a Simple Breakfast
One of Martha's favorite things to do is to make jam with the perfectly ripened fruit and berries grown on her Bedford farm; Martha shares her favorite recipes, as well as jam and jarring techniques.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E3 — How to Properly Cook an Egg
Meet Martha in one of her favorite places on the farm - the chicken coop to talk about one of her favorite things to eat - eggs; Martha will share her top methods for making an egg-cellent breakfast.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E5 — Shellfish
Martha takes shellfish to the next level with sustainable oysters, baked stuffed clams and more.

title: Martha Cooks
description:
S1 E6 — Steak Night
From a pan seared steak with bordelaise sauce to a classic sizzling steak fired up on the grill, Martha makes steak dinners cooked to perfection with the help of her Head of Culinary at the farm.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E38 — Halloween Fun for Kids
Garden insects; pop-up books; chicken costume; German-style baked pancakes; hermit cookies; gumdrop spiders.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E41 — Fleece Halloween Costumes
Chef Alfred Portale; community websites; perennial border; squash candlesticks; tree costume; cooking cabbage.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S9 E42 — Halloween in Space
Halloween decorating; rocket-shaped cookies; space-alien costume; savory salmon steamed in parchment.

title: Martha Stewart Living
description:
S1 E6 — Halloween Party; Caramel Apples; Box Lantern; Cookies
Adult Halloween party; caramel apples; pumpkins.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E7 — Fishmonger
Seafood chef Dave Pasternack explains buying, butchering and storing fish; boning a round or flat fish; cleaning a squid; crudo.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E9 — Dumplings
Italian dumplings gnocchi and gnudi; Polish pierogi.

title: Martha Stewart's Cooking School
description:
S2 E11 — Preserving
Duck confit; lemon and tomato confits work well with grilled or roasted meats; gravlax, a cured salmon appetizer.
